items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Don replaced Joe Farrell. It was Joe and then Menza and then Frank Vicari was the third tenor player.

ctx.x: Were you there when Don Menza came through?
Yeah. Don replaced Joe Farrell. It was Joe and then Menza and then Frank Vicari was the third tenor player. And then the band broke up, not because of that, but shortly after that.
What was the travel situation like, the road? Was it a tough grind in those days?
